assumptions.choice: Placed as a bt.Order.Stop order upon entry execution at entry_price * 0.98 for long and entry_price * 1.02 for short.
assumptions.reason: Standard Backtrader mechanism to execute stop-loss exits intra-bar at the specified percentage threshold.

assumptions.choice: Reset setup tracking (rsi_low1 / rsi_high1) when RSI reaches the opposite extreme zone (>70 for long setup, <30 for short setup) or upon trade entry.
assumptions.reason: Prevents invalid or stale failure swing patterns from triggering trades after major trend changes or past trades.

assumptions.choice: RSI cross above 30 is defined as rsi[-1] < 30 and rsi[0] >= 30; cross below 70 is rsi[-1] > 70 and rsi[0] <= 70; cross above 70 is rsi[-1] <= 70 and rsi[0] > 70; cross below 30 is rsi[-1] >= 30 and rsi[0] < 30.
assumptions.reason: Provides exact discrete bar crossover boundaries matching standard Backtrader technical indicator interpretations.
